claims.evidence: Witness only described the front view (headlight/indicator/label/brand text). No clear evidence of overall cleanliness, body condition, or wear beyond the front.

claims.claim: Battery ran down; new owner will replace the batteries
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include battery/starting test results or electrical checks.
No photo evidence of a remote, remote receiver, or remote-start feature.
No year/date, receipt, or odometer/mileage evidence shown.
No transmission/gear condition or brake test/close-up of brake components shown.
Only front view details are described; no full-frame/chassis/body inspection reported.
No parts identification/serials or component close-ups provided to confirm originality.

risks.risk: Engine condition unknown (may not start or may have internal issues).
risks.proof: Short video clip of a cold start (or start after sitting), plus 1–2 minutes idling and smooth throttle response.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed running/engine condition unknown.

risks.risk: Battery/electrical health unknown (seller says battery ran down).
risks.proof: Video showing charging/starting attempt with a known-good battery (or jump start), and a full electrical check: headlight, indicators, horn, brake light.

risks.risk: Transmission type and condition unknown (gear/automatic not shown).
risks.proof: Video showing gear engagement (or drive/reverse selection if automatic) and smooth movement without slipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for transmission needing attention.

risks.risk: Brake condition unknown (pads/discs/drums wear not shown).
risks.proof: Clip of braking test at low speed showing strong, even braking; plus close-up photos of front and rear brake components.
risks.if_unproven: Price as brakes may need service.

risks.risk: Tyre tread/age unknown (affects safety and replacement cost).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (front and rear) showing tread depth and sidewall condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres may be near replacement.

risks.risk: Frame/chassis/body condition unknown (cracks, bends, repairs, rust not fully visible).
risks.proof: Walk-around video and close-ups of frame welds, fork area, both sides of body panels, and underbody where possible.
Photo of engine label/ID plate showing engine capacity and model, plus odometer reading.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for lower capacity/unknown spec.

risks.risk: Paper/registration status unknown (could be unregistered or problematic).
risks.proof: Photos of ownership papers/receipt/registration documents and any service history.

proof_requests: Video of the scooter starting and running smoothly (idle + throttle) and a short ride at low speed.
Electrical test video: headlight, both indicators, horn, brake light; confirm charging behavior.
Close-up photos of tyres (front and rear) showing tread and sidewall condition.
Close-up photos of front and rear brakes (pads/discs/drums) and a braking test clip.
Photo of engine ID/label showing engine capacity and model; include odometer reading.
Walk-around video showing frame/chassis and both sides for cracks/bends/rust/repairs.
Photos of ownership/registration papers and receipt (to support 'bought new 6 months ago').
If claiming remote starter: show the remote, receiver, and demonstrate remote start working.
response.reason: The witness can confirm brand text and front features, but key value drivers (engine size, running condition, brakes, tyres, electrical health, and papers) are not shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be too speculative; request proof first.
